topic: An employee is transferred to a different department
text: I can't believe they've moved me over here to this new department. I was just getting everything figured out, everything was falling into place. Now I have to start all over, learn the ropes in a completely different setup. They say it's a step up, but I don't see it. Just more work, more pressure. I don’t need this. I was doing fine where I was, making real progress. This is just throwing me into the deep end without so much as a warning. I bet they think they're being clever, but I’m not buying it. I’ve got a lot to prove now, and I don’t like it one bit.
